heading: FOGSI Gynae Endoscopy Skill Course 9th Batch
content:
FOGSI Gynae Endoscopy Skill Course 9th Batch

ILS Hospitals Salt Lake is recognized as FOGSI (Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India) / IAGE Gynae Endoscopic Training Center in Eastern India.  ILS Academia, Salt Lake is conducting basic and advanced courses in Gynae endoscopy at regular intervals. Attending students get 40 hours of hands-on training, didactic lectures, OT observer ship, and pre & post evaluation and suturing training. Every participant will receive a Fellowship Training Certificate from FOGSI / ILS Hospitals. Till 2022 ILS Academia Salt Lake has successfully conducted 8 batches of FOGSI/IAGE Gynae Endoscopic Training.

title: Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT)
excerpt: The Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) is a program that trains students in various aspects of laboratory testing and analysis in the field of healthcare.
content:
1. The Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) is a program that trains students in various aspects of laboratory testing and analysis in the field of healthcare. It covers subjects such as clinical pathology, microbiology, biochemistry, and hematology. To enroll in a DMLT course, you typically need to have completed your 10+2 education in the science stream.
  2. To pursue a DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology) course in West Bengal, you can explore options offered by medical colleges or institutions recognized by the West Bengal State Medical Faculty (WBSMF).

Contact WBSMF or visit their official website for a list of approved institutes and admission

To become a Dialysis Technician in West Bengal, you can consider enrolling in a relevant course offered by recognized institutions. A Dialysis Technician course typically covers various aspects related to renal care and the operation of dialysis equipment. Here’s a general overview:

  • Duration: The program has a two-year academic period.
  • Eligibility: Candidates often need a 10+2 (or equivalent) qualification with a background in science.
  • Curriculum:
    • Anatomy and Physiology: Understanding the structure and function of the human body, especially focusing on the renal system.
    • Pathophysiology: Study of abnormal physiological processes related to kidney diseases.
    • Dialysis Techniques: In-depth knowledge and hands-on training in different dialysis procedures.
  • Patient Care: Learning how to provide care for patients undergoing dialysis, including monitoring vital signs and recognizing complications.
  • Medical Ethics and Laws: Understanding the ethical and legal aspects of healthcare.
  • Practical Training: A significant portion of the course involves hands-on training in dialysis units. This practical experience is crucial for becoming proficient in operating dialysis machines and managing patient care during dialysis sessions.
  • Internship: Mandatory internship in hospitals or dialysis centers. This provides students with real-world experience and helps them apply theoretical knowledge in a clinical setting.
  • Certification: Upon completing the course, students may receive a certification as a Dialysis Technician.
